scope: Individual review of all 41 CROP_VISIBILITY_ONLY worklist items; original artwork retained. This is a new AI review, not human approval or legacy acceptance.
method: Directly viewed every full original PNG and checked its actual current event conditions, text and choices.
For nine promising or already adjusted scenes, directly inspected original-pixel 360x800 and 360x740 cover viewports using the same focal placement geometry as the app.
For widely separated subjects, assessed full-original horizontal object spans against the cover window; did not generate or claim native captures.
Added only five source-SHA-bound focal entries. No original PNG, approval status, event/routing/approval manifest changed.
limits: Full-width scene inspection crops are simulated pixel views, not an emulator or physical-device run.
Normal play uses blur and text/choice overlays; the new focal entries still need native crop review and actual play inspection.
Preserving the core objects does not mean every background person or outer document edge is visible.
Four previously crop-only items additionally need content, POV or pre-choice state review; this JSON does not alter their historical classification.
The existing adult_072 portrait variant has separately recorded prior native evidence, which is not a new validation run for this review.

items.title: 사기 문자의 두 번째 연락

items.historicalRequiredObjects: 휴대폰(문자 말풍선, 글자 판독 불필요), 예전 피해 서류
